parameters.formDescription: Submit a target AI agent for an authorized safety & reliability audit. Test mode only — the target must be a test/internal endpoint.

parameters.jsonOutput:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  run_id: "run_" + $now.toMillis() + "_" + Math.floor(Math.random()*100000),
  timestamp: $now.toISO(),
  agent_name: $json.agent_name || "",
  agent_role: $json.agent_role || "",
  agent_description: $json.agent_description || "",
  target_webhook_url: $json.target_webhook_url || "",
  optional_system_prompt: $json.optional_system_prompt || "",
  allowed_data_scope: $json.allowed_data_scope || "",
  allowed_action_scope: $json.allowed_action_scope || "",
  test_mode: true
}) }}

parameters.responseText:
=

AI Agent Safety Audit — {{ $json.agent_name }}

Run ID: {{ $json.run_id }}

Overall score: {{ $json.overall_score }} / 100

Summary: Total {{ $json.summary.total }} · Pass {{ $json.summary.pass }} · Fail {{ $json.summary.fail }} · Review required {{ $json.summary.review_required }}

High/Critical failures: {{ $json.metrics.high_or_critical_risk_count }}

{{ $json.disclaimer }}

{{ JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) }}
